name: walkthrough
description: Create narrated walkthrough films from real web-product use, then revise retained footage. For Apple Silicon Macs; requires the separate Walkthrough CLI, Node 24, FFmpeg and local Voices. Setup explicitly acquires runtime dependencies and a browser; plugin installation starts no recording or inference. Removing the plugin preserves the CLI and projects.

interface.shortDescription: Real product use. A film worth following.
interface.longDescription: Give your agent a web product, audience and intent. It explores real interactions, records them and delivers a narrated local film you can revise without repeating application work. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac, the separately installed Walkthrough CLI, Node 24, FFmpeg and local Voices with provisioned models and a saved narrator. Setup explicitly acquires pinned runtime dependencies and a browser; authoring performs no dependency downloads. Remotion and model terms apply separately. This plugin supplies guidance, not a hidden runtime: installation starts no browser, recording or inference. Disabling or removing it preserves the CLI, projects, profiles, voices and models; any active session remains under the independent CLI's inspect/close controls.
defaultPrompt: Make a walkthrough film introducing this web product to the audience I describe.
Revise my retained walkthrough film's pacing and framing without reopening the product.
